title: Heat transfer fluids: amino acid anion ionic liquid based IoNanofluids with remarkable thermal conductivity and low viscosity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23146-23164
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03752B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Anshu Chandra, Yamini Sudha Sistla, Mir Atiq Ahmed, Durga Vijay Shankar Vasireddy, Nancy Jaglan, Nipu Kumar Das, Tamal Banerjee, Venkata Subbarayudu Sistla
This study introduces MWCNT incorporated amino acid anion ionic liquid based IoNanofluids having remarkably low viscosity, high thermal conductivity, high specific heat capacity and colloidal stability for heat transfer fluid applications.
